metrics.name: Open Alert Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. There is no Alerts[] array on any dataprint shape, so alert severity, age and policy name are not available.

metrics.name: Antivirus Definitions Not Up to Date
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. definitionStatus is the exact string 'Up-to-Date' (hyphenated, mixed case).

metrics.name: Devices Without Active Antivirus
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. 'No AV' is the string 'NONE' in productName, not null; productState is null on those rows. AntiVirusSummary can have fewer rows than Devices (22 for 29 devices on one test system), so also compare length(AntiVirusSummary) with length(Devices) to find devices with no AV record at all.

metrics.name: Agent Device Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. deviceType values: AgentDevice, VMHost, VMGuest. When NinjaOne monitors an ESXi host, each VM appears once as a VMGuest record and again as an AgentDevice if it also runs the agent, so devices-total-count double-counts those VMs. Use this primitive as the managed-endpoint count and for seat reconciliation.

metrics.name: Devices With Failed OS Patches
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. The stored metric's description says 'more than 1' but the query counts devices with at least one failure.

metrics.name: Devices With Failed Software Patches
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only.

metrics.name: Devices With a Volume Below 20% Free
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. PercentageFree_r exists on the per-device Devices[].volumes[] array, not on the top-level Volumes[] array.

metrics.name: Needs-Attention Device Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only.

metrics.name: Devices Not Updated in 14 Days
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. DaysSinceLastUpdated_r is an integer number of days, computed at inspection time.

metrics.name: Offline Device Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. Offline is the state at inspection time; use devices-offline-list for how long each device has been out of contact.

metrics.name: Offline Device List
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Devices[?offline == `true`].{name: systemName, lastContact: LastContact_r, nodeClass: nodeClass}
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. LastContact_r is ISO 8601; the raw lastContact is epoch SECONDS (a float), unlike UserSession[].logonTime, which is epoch milliseconds.

metrics.name: Online Device Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. Devices[].offline is a boolean (false = online); use the backtick-quoted literal.

metrics.name: Devices Pending Reboot
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. Devices[].os.needsReboot is a boolean. DeviceHealth_r.pendingRebootReason is usually an empty string, so do not filter on it.

metrics.name: Server Device Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. Observed nodeClass values: WINDOWS_WORKSTATION, WINDOWS_SERVER, VMWARE_VM_HOST, VMWARE_VM_GUEST. Hypervisor hosts and guests are not counted as servers.

metrics.name: Total Device Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only; a parent dataprint has no Devices key. Matches the asset-inventory count of devices whose inspectors[] contains ninja-rmm-inspector.

metrics.name: Unhealthy Device Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. healthStatus values observed: HEALTHY, NEEDS_ATTENTION, UNHEALTHY, UNKNOWN.

metrics.name: Windows 10 Device Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. os.name is null on VMHost / VMGuest records; without the || '' guard, contains() fails the whole query. Lean children report 'Microsoft Windows 10 Pro', expanded children 'Windows 10 Professional Edition', so match with contains(), never equality.

metrics.name: Physical Disks Not OK
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. DiskSummary is present on lean and expanded child shapes.

metrics.name: Organization Count
metrics.gotcha: Parent system only. Each organization can become a child system; Discovered[] lists them, with Inspector = 'ninja-rmm-inspector'.

metrics.name: Critical/Important Pending Patch Count
metrics.gotcha: Expanded child shape only; PatchStatus[] is absent on lean children and length() then fails. Observed severity values: IMPORTANT, MODERATE, OPTIONAL, NONE, and null on most third-party (PatchKind_r == 'SOFTWARE') rows. CRITICAL was not observed in test data but is kept in the filter. Observed status values: APPROVED, DELAYED, MANUAL, REJECTED.

metrics.name: Failed Patch Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. OsPatchInstallHistory[] showed only INSTALLED rows in test data, so failures come from DeviceHealth_r, not install history.

metrics.name: Pending Patch Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only (the parent holds the tenant roster). Works on lean and expanded shapes because it reads the per-device DeviceHealth_r rollup, not PatchStatus[].

metrics.name: Automatic Services Not Running
metrics.gotcha: Expanded child shape only. startType values: AUTO_START, AUTO_START_DELAYED, DEMAND_START, DISABLED; state values: RUNNING, STOPPED. One test system returned exactly 1000 rows, which suggests a collection cap, so treat counts on large tenants as a floor. Many delayed-start and trigger-start services stop normally; review the names before calling them failures.

metrics.name: Installed Software Record Count
metrics.gotcha: Expanded child shape only. Rows are per device, so this is not a unique-title count (JMESPath has no distinct). Can run to thousands of rows; filter by name or publisher rather than pulling the whole array.

metrics.name: Active Threat Count
metrics.gotcha: Child systems only. Only populated for security products NinjaOne integrates with; a third-party EDR reports its own threats in its own inspector.

metrics.name: Technician MFA Enabled Count
metrics.gotcha: Parent system only. mfaConfigured is a boolean; use the backtick-quoted literal.

metrics.name: Enabled Administrator Count
metrics.gotcha: Parent system only.

metrics.name: Technician Count
metrics.gotcha: Parent system only. Child dataprints also have a Users[] array, but it holds END_USER contacts (or is empty), so length(Users) on a child is not a technician count.

metrics.name: Enabled Users Without MFA
metrics.gotcha: Evaluate against the parent system, where Users[] are technicians. Accounts with invitationStatus 'EXPIRED' are still enabled and count here.

metrics.name: Enabled Users Without MFA List
metrics.gotcha: Parent system only. Returns [firstName, lastName] pairs, not email addresses.

metrics.name: Volumes Without BitLocker Protection
metrics.gotcha: Expanded child shape only; the top-level Volumes[] array is absent on lean children, and Devices[].volumes[].bitLockerStatus is null there. Counts volumes, not devices; removable and data volumes are included.
